answer: Deposits are visible in dawn, and tundra reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 30% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 96 aliases, and each one needs its own funded tide account. A farm of 3783 identities would post 2133 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
